name: SK Inc.
summary: SK Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in petroleum refining, telecommunications, wholesale and retail, chemicals, construction, and other businesses in Korea. It is involved in city gas and power generation; gas stations; sale of asphalt; energy business; resource development; LNG business; electricity and other electric wire installation; new regeneration; and hydrogen business.
